param: Λ Birth rate into the susceptible children population. Assumed for population stability.
β_C Transmission rate for measles among children.
β_A Transmission rate for measles among adults.
ε Vaccine failure factor, derived from vaccine effectiveness of 86%. (1-ε) is vaccine effectiveness.
β_C_breakthrough Effective transmission rate for breakthrough infections in un-monitored vaccinated children.
β_A_breakthrough Effective transmission rate for breakthrough infections in un-monitored vaccinated adults. (Assumed based on symmetry with children's group).
x_U Vaccination rate for the Un-monitored Vaccination program for children.
x_M Vaccination rate for the Monitored Vaccination program for children.
x_A Vaccination rate for the adult catch-up program.
h_U Rate of acquiring full immunity for children in the Un-monitored Vaccination program.
h_M Rate of acquiring full immunity for children in the Monitored Vaccination program.
h_A Rate of acquiring full immunity for adults in the catch-up vaccination program.
δ Progression rate from Exposed to Infectious (1 / 10 days incubation).
γ Recovery rate for infectious individuals (1 / 2 weeks recovery period).
j Maturation rate from child to adult group (1 / 15 years).
d Disease-induced death rate for measles.
